technical_change: Both the official TypeScript and Python SDKs added a script to generate an OAuth scopes file and added generic API endpoint support, as mirrored PRs in the same week. Remaining releases in the window (TS v2.2.48/50/51, Python v2.1.76/78/79) carried no described changes beyond a changelog diff link.
who_is_affected: Developers automating SailPoint ISC through the official SDKs
implementation_impact: Minor developer-experience / tooling change, not a new product capability. Continues to evidence an actively maintained public SDK ecosystem, which was already noted qualitatively in matrix row E3.
material_change_since_last: First observation logged for this item; too low-materiality on its own to move the E3 verdict out of unseeded.
